verdict.rationale: Docs show Factory creates isolated working directories/worktrees for sessions (factory-docs-23) and supports registering machines (BYOM) as execution environments (factory-docs-24), implying some automated environment setup, and droid analyzes the codebase before acting (factory-docs-18). However there is no explicit documentation of automatic repo cloning or dependency installation as part of session bootstrapping. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic git clone step, explicit dependency installation (e.g., npm install/pip install) automation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of full autonomous environment setup.
